cta_text.description: The ONE CTA phrase, one of allowed_cta_texts for the ad's angle (sale, financing, story, else default; the hard constraints list the phrases for this run). The renderer repeats it down the page and in the sticky bar.

cta_url.description: The ONE CTA destination. No other url, link, button or phone field may appear anywhere in page.json (gate landing:second_cta).

eyebrow.description: Who the page is for (or the sale), at most 8 words. Figures only as tokens ({rating}, {offer_amount}, ...).

headline.description: 6-12 words: the ad's hook restated as closely as the verified facts allow (same words, same number, same person). Figures only as tokens: "{offer_amount} off the <model>, today's price ends {deadline_day}".

accent_phrase.description: 1-4 words copied from headline; shown in brand red (no accent when not found).

subhead.description: The outcome and the time frame, about 20 words (at most 30). Testimonial ads: the speaker's strongest line from transcript_or_text, word for word in quotes, credited "In the ad, she says".

hero_image.description: Fallback product photo; the ad still (when the run has one) or the product cut-out is shown first.

reasons.description: 3-5 reasons to believe the ad's promise (3-4 on an offer-led page: the renderer adds the sale first). Cover the Value Equation: outcome, likelihood, time, effort.

headline.description: At most 10 words, the reader's outcome first.

body.description: At most 45 words: one sentence on how it works, one with the spec that makes it true.

proof_ref.description: Optional: the claim_id of one review quote, the store rating or the units line that backs this reason.

asset_role.description: Optional: the photo beside it -- people | room | detail | exterior.

checked_claims.description: RETIRED (cycle 110): never write it -- the gate refuses it. Pages written before cycle 110 still render their verified facts.

room_photo.description: Retired (cycle 110): omit it; the renderer picks every photo from the library.

benefits.description: PROOF LOOK ONLY (write it only when the hard constraints say the page renders in the proof look; otherwise omit). 4-6 check-mark rows, each a plain noun phrase of at most 8 words with claim_ids; at least one id per row is a product spec or benefit claim or a benefit allowlist id.

text.description: A plain noun phrase, at most 8 words, no full stop.

icon_row.description: PROOF LOOK ONLY (otherwise omit). 3-4 icon cells before the closing band, each {icon_key, label, claim_ids}. icon_key is one of the fixed keys the hard constraints list; no key twice.

icon_key.description: One of: shipping, warranty, red_light, full_spectrum, wood, us_owned, delivery, assembly.

claim_ids.description: At least 1 id from facts_pack.verified_claims that states it.

proof.description: Optional. The rating is rendered from facts_pack; quote only one customer review copied verbatim from facts_pack.review_quotes. The rating sentence in reviews_summary is never a quote. Omit when review_quotes is empty.

questions.description: 3-5 questions a buyer asks before spending this much (will I use it, session length or heat-up time when verified, will it fit, paying over time, HSA/FSA only when verified); at most one logistics question; never returns. Question <= 12 words; answer first, <= 35 words; claim_ids on any number, price, spec or trigger word.

closing.description: The closing band. The renderer adds the price, the deadline and the CTA pill.

headline.description: At most 10 words: the outcome or the offer in one line (figures only as tokens).
